reviewer: Codex same-Agent review with attributed external audio-model perception; no independent whole-video or business approval
method: Inspected all eight localized caption/CTA instances in actual candidate galleries, original source timeline crops, full-frame candidate evidence and caption boundary frames. Reviewed decoded glyph timing, actual candidate WAV identity and source/candidate external audio comparisons. Findings include visual failures; scores never override them.
lesson: Same-source six-language preparation can share source analysis and background separation, but any visual repair defect propagates to every language. Source-local classical inpainting produced obvious patches; local LaMa improved text removal but left soft clothing/hair, apple/hand ghosting and source-colour/glyph fragments at transitions. These candidate videos remain revise. Exact native script, actual mixed-audio DTW, independent transcription, decoded glyph boundary measurements and mux timebase correlation are separate evidence. An invalid optional accent was rejected at createTask; singleton JSON review envelopes were recovered locally from saved receipts without another charge. One source and six locales are not six independent source validations.
limitations: Source-burned captions overlap moving clothing, hair, apple and fingers. Repairs create visible soft regions/ghost edges and occasional source-colour/glyph fragments around text transitions.
Uniform green native subtitles simplify the original per-word green/red/white highlight animation.
Native female dubbed audio retains original English mouth movements; no lip synchronization was performed.
Audio preservation is supported by local source separation, original post-7.8s samples, and external model perception; lossless separation is not claimed.
Same-Agent review plus external audio model and pixel/ASR measurements is not independent native-speaker, company or business acceptance.
curation_boundary: Existing task records checked; selected contact sheets inspected. No new full-video or listening review; omitted historical paths are not live dependencies.
